title: SurgCBVR: A Multi-Domain Benchmark for Content-Based Surgical Video-to-Video Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2611.23347v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hospitals record thousands of hours of surgical video annually, yet these archives remain difficult to search by content. Surgeons cannot readily retrieve similar operations, complications, or workflow events. Existing surgical computer vision primarily produces labels rather than retrieving relevant videos. We introduce SurgCBVR, the first benchmark for content-based video-to-video retrieval in surgery. It integrates eight public datasets across four domains-ophthalmic, laparoscopic, robotic-assisted, and colonoscopy-covering six procedure types, 679 cases, and 76,489 clips (106 hours). SurgCBVR comprises two tiers: Scene, retrieving the same operative state across cases and sites, and Workflow, retrieving and localizing phase transitions and deviations. Scene includes 74,765 clips spanning 40 classes, three temporal granularities, and three playback speeds; Workflow contains 1,724 transition clips. Fixed clip lengths and frame counts

translated_title: SurgCBVR：面向基于内容的手术视频到视频检索的多领域基准数据集
translated_abstract: 医院每年记录数千小时的手术视频，然而这些档案库仍然难以按内容进行检索。外科医生无法方便地检索相似的手术、并发症或工作流事件。现有的手术计算机视觉研究主要产生标签，而非检索相关视频。我们提出了SurgCBVR，这是首个面向手术领域基于内容的视频到视频检索的基准数据集。它整合了来自四个领域（眼科、腹腔镜、机器人辅助和结肠镜检查）的八个公开数据集，涵盖六种手术类型、679个病例和76,489个视频片段（共106小时）。SurgCBVR包含两个层级：场景层，用于跨病例和跨机构检索相同的手术状态；工作流层，用于检索并定位手术阶段转换和偏差。场景层包含74,765个视频片段，涵盖40个类别、三种时间粒度和三种播放速度；工作流层包含1,724个转换片段。固定的片段长度和帧数
tldr: SurgCBVR是首个面向手术领域的基于内容的视频到视频检索基准，整合了四个领域八个公开数据集共76,489个视频片段，支持跨病例场景检索与工作流阶段转换定位两大检索任务。
en_tdlr: SurgCBVR is the first benchmark for content-based surgical video-to-video retrieval, integrating eight public datasets across four domains with 76,489 clips, supporting both cross-case scene retrieval and workflow phase transition localization tasks.
